finding: The proposal says that the implementation agent files a QA finding when the gate-check step cannot resolve something, such as a surviving mutant. No Scenario states this. The Scenario 'The wave close routes the open QA findings by owner' starts from QA-0012 and QA-0013 without a severity, while dispatch add accepts only an open blocking finding (BR-117), so a minor QA-0012 in the register would make add refuse. Add a Scenario in which the implementation agent files a blocking QA finding with an owner for a mutant it cannot resolve, and make the routing Scenario say that QA-0012 is an open blocking finding. Owner: requirements-agent.
why_this_severity: BR-117 and the proposal say which findings add accepts, so a test writer can add the missing severity (no to fails_purpose); the writer of RL-12-LN-01 and RL-12-IT-01 must find the filing rule in the proposal instead of the spec (raises_cost).
